### Read
- `l1-face.mjs --pr 36821` at this head: CLEAN, 13 items. Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #36538`: items 1–5 and the review notes N10, N12–N16 added to the card are each addressed, so the PR delivers the whole card. No other card is bound. Changeset covers `@object-ui/i18n` (published); `@object-ui/app-shell` is private. `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` match the claim. Checks: 45 success / 13 expected skip / 0 failed, Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check success.
- Scope: all 18 files are inside the claim's surface (the three design-mode files, their `__tests__`, and the design-mode strings in `ui/packages/i18n/**` for the hint and two bar sentences). No contract face: the new `AppMenuSaveTexts` members and the `publish` door option sit in a private package; nothing under `packages/spec/src/**`; no governed path.
- New strings: `designMode.menu.storedUnread`, `.publishedMoved`, `.keyboardHint` in all eleven packs. en and zh-Hans read correctly; zh-Hant is generated.
- Changeset read sentence by sentence against the diff: true at this head.
- Card items against the tree:
  1. Id-less twins: `storedKeyer` claims, per level, the served entries carrying the stored entry's own keys first (`servedAs`, id and children left out), then by place. A hidden twin no longer takes a shown one's key.
  2. A 404 stored read: `holdsStoredApp` (all layers null) refuses in `prepareAppMenuSave` with the bar sentence, and `readStoredMenu` answers `null`. That also turns Studio's new-object-joins-menu path to its existing refusal on a 404, a same-class change the body names.
  3. Contributed groups: left out of 「Move to group」, end-zone and entry drops, 「Add menu item」 and add-beside.
  4. Version pin: the publish carries the `/layers` read's `overlayVersion` as `If-Match`, or `If-None-Match: *`. The pin for an installed app is read at the pair before the body. I checked the premise on this head: the publish door reads the precondition (`meta-item-history-routes.ts`, #36601, pinned by `meta-item-publish-version-pin.test.ts`), and `MetadataClient.publish` forwards `ifMatch` / `ifNoneMatch`. A `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` resets the draft and says `publishedMoved`.
  5. Each item has its own case with a control.
- N12/N15/N16 click guards: separate `pointerDrag` / `keyboardDrag` / `pointerHeld` flags, and the window is stamped at release. N13: `MENU_KEYBOARD_CODES` (Space starts, Enter opens a link not picked up) plus a hint line and screen-reader instructions. N14: the collision rule returns no target for a pointer outside the menu box; a keyboard move keeps `closestCenter`.
- Tests: real commands and output, and 19 single-line ablations, every one red and restored to blob == HEAD. One flake was seen once and did not reproduce in three reruns. The browser was not driven (jsdom only); the body declares it.

### Findings
- N1 (disclosed, widened). Item 3's residual covers more than the pending window the body names. `contributed()` reads `storedById`, so it is also empty after a stored read that **failed** (non-404). For the whole session, a contributed group is then still offered, and a move into it is saved at the end of the stored top level. Small user effect, for the seat's report.
- N2 (disclosed). The N10 draw order after a failed stored read: drawn after the foreign run, stored before it. Nothing wrong is written.
- N3 (disclosed). An ensure-door pair that was neither listed nor created by this call publishes unpinned, as before. Small user effect, for the seat's report.
- N4. `servedAs` compares keys with `JSON.stringify`, so a nested object served with its keys in another order fails the exact match. It then falls back to the place match this PR replaces, the pre-PR behaviour. No effect beyond that.
- N5. The keyboard hint is a new always-visible line under the design-mode menu title (the card's N13 asks for it in the editor's help). No action.

No finding above nit is open on this head. Landing items for the area: `Fixes #36538` closes the card on merge, then remove `pm:dispatched` with the close-out. Claim 7118501805 noted that #36692 would touch the same `DesignModeMenu.tsx` block: whichever lands second merges.
